xPosts.author: Alex Finn
xPosts.text: Grok Bot is easily the best AI agent on planet Earth right now. People want more tokens; he covers 7 tricks to 10x usage from Grok Bot.

xPosts.author: Alex Finn
xPosts.text: You can send this to your grok bot and have it implement everything.

xPosts.author: Elon Musk
xPosts.text: Grok @Bot can call your dentist on the phone!

xPosts.author: Alex Finn
xPosts.text: This year we saw the 3 most important AI releases ever: Grok Bot, Opus 5.5, Hermes Agent. Used together they can build a business, generate revenue, and automate unwanted tasks.

xPosts.author: Alex Finn
xPosts.text: Deepseek article on AI agents: routers vs workers (chief-of-staff model works well in Grok Bot), proactive on events not chats, message queue, watchdog layer, protect human attention. Grok Bot already strong on several of these.

xPosts.author: Elon Musk
xPosts.text: Try Grok @Bot! You will love it. We land a few dozen fixes, features and sometimes powers to Bot 7 days a week and we look at your feedback to make Bot as perfect as possible.

xPosts.author: Elon Musk
xPosts.text: I know it’s taken longer than expected, but Grok 4.8 will not be a disappointment. We’re not optimizing for benchmarks and I really don’t care how Grok does on those, but it will be incredibly useful.

xPosts.author: Alex Finn
xPosts.text: Grok Bot just had its biggest update yet. It introduces pages and dashboards, 2 things that solve Grok's BIGGEST problem. Video covering 5 dashboards that make Grok Bot much nicer to use, including one that saves a ton of usage.

xPosts.author: SpaceX Super Intelligence
xPosts.text: Introducing Grok Voice 3.0, the world’s most intelligent speech-to-speech model. Excels at resolving customer calls, responds in under a second, costs less than other frontier models. $0.08/min.

briefs.title: Grok Bot serving costs force tighter usage limits; practitioners publish workarounds
points: Musk confirmed Nov 1 that Grok Bot serving costs were unsustainably high relative to revenue; weekly allowances were reduced (users reported hitting 100% early over the Halloween weekend).
No public numbers on the new caps; Musk pointed users toward higher-tier plans for more usage.
Alex Finn (practitioner): Grok Bot is currently the best AI agent; published a video with 7 techniques to stretch token usage substantially (Nov 5).
Product continues shipping: Bot can place phone calls (dentist insurance check example); Grok Build multi-agent reliability upgrades; daily fixes noted by Musk.
AA Intelligence Index v5 (latest readings): Gemini 4 Carbon 60 (limited), Claude Opus 5.5 ~59, GPT-6 Astra ~57, GPT-6.1 Sol 55, Claude Sonnet 5.5 ~55, Grok 4.7 ~35. Pricing unchanged.
API text watermark for grok-4.7 / 4.6 / 4.5 / 4.3 and selected 4.20 variants goes live Nov 7.
briefs.assumption: Exact new weekly allowance figures not published; unit economics of always-on agents remain under pressure until cheaper inference or pricing adjustments. Grok 4.8 still has no firm public date.

briefs.title: Grok API text watermark starts Nov 7; Bot Pages continue to mature
points: SpaceXSI docs: from Nov 7, text from grok-4.7 / 4.6 / 4.5 / 4.3 and selected 4.20 variants will include an invisible statistical watermark by default (Responses and Chat Completions). Team admins can opt out per model; opt-outs audit-logged.
Grok Bot Pages & dashboards (shipped ~Oct 29) seeing practitioner adoption; Alex Finn highlights router/worker + attention-protection patterns that already match Grok Bot’s chief-of-staff design.
Musk continues RTing strong Grok Bot user feedback and notes daily fixes/features.

AA Intelligence Index v5 (private-test heavy) still ranks Grok 4.7 ~35 vs Gemini 4 Carbon 59, Claude Opus 5.5 58, GPT-6 Astra 57. Pricing unchanged: Grok $2/$6, Opus $4/$20, Astra $10/$50, Sol $2/$10.
briefs.assumption: Watermark is statistical/invisible and does not alter model behavior; exact opt-out scope and downstream redistribution impact still to be observed. Grok 4.8 timeline remains unconfirmed.

briefs.title: Musk: Grok 4.8 delayed but will be useful; not optimizing for benchmarks
points: Musk posts that Grok 4.8 has taken longer than expected but “will not be a disappointment.”
Explicitly states not optimizing for benchmarks; prioritizes usefulness.
Earlier (Sep 14): 2.5T model trained on new C++ stack finishing pretrain then RL; 4.8 noticeable improvement, 4.9 probably Astra/Fable class, Grok 5 maybe better than anything.
AA Intelligence Index v5 (Oct 27) ranks Grok 4.7 ~35; leaders Claude Opus 5.5 ~58, GPT-6 Astra ~57, Gemini 4 Carbon 59 (limited).
briefs.assumption: Grok 4.8 public release still weeks away; exact AA recovery unknown until independent measurement.

briefs.title: Grok Bot ships pages and dashboards
points: Alex Finn (practitioner) calls it the biggest Grok Bot update yet.
Pages and dashboards address prior usability limits; video demos multiple dashboards including one that reduces usage.
Bot continues to run on its own cloud computer with connectors and app access.

briefs.title: Grok Voice 3.0 launches at $0.08/min
points: Speech-to-speech model with sub-second latency.
Same price as Voice 2.0; available in Voice Agent API and Builder.
SpaceX reports 70% of Starlink support calls resolved autonomously.
Powers voice mode in Grok Bot and Tesla.

briefs.title: Grok 4.7 ships as current flagship
points: Released Sep 21; available in API (grok-4.7), Cursor, Grok Build, Bedrock, Foundry.
Pricing held at $2 input / $6 output per M (cached $0.5); 500k context.
Reasoning effort low/medium/high/xhigh; positioned for coding, agents, knowledge work.
Lab claims improvements on CursorBench, DeepSWE, verification, longer tasks.
